# Bottlenecker

Bottlenecker is a free, browser-based tool for detecting system architecture bottlenecks
before they hit production. No signup required.

## What It Does
- Visual canvas: drag-and-drop load generators, load balancers, servers, databases, caches and queues
- Load simulation: a load generator emits QPS; traffic is split across edges (auto, percent or absolute)
  and each component has a capacity limit
- Bottleneck detection: utilisation is re-computed on every change; overloaded nodes turn red
- Error rate & latency modeling: see downstream cascade effects
- Critical path: the slowest request path, with mean latency and end-to-end success rate
- Retry amplification simulation: model retry storms behind failing components

## Who It's For
Software engineers, system designers, and architects who want to validate their
architecture under load before writing a single line of code.

## Key Features
- The simulation runs in your browser and your diagrams never leave it
  (the site counts anonymous usage events and shows Google AdSense ads; see /privacy)
- Free, no account required
- Supports: load generators, load balancers, servers (instances), databases (read/write
  split, read replicas), caches (Redis/Memcached), queues (Kafka/RabbitMQ/SQS)
- Export diagrams as JSON, PNG or JPG; share a diagram as a link
- Lessons: real-world bottleneck scenarios you can open on the canvas
